name: Slow Down Perth 2020

venue.name: Meerilinga, West Leederville
venue.details: It is in training room 1. Please note that spectator space is limited and parking is on the street only.

information:
Please note: There is no 3x3x3 Cube being held at this competition!
The main event of this competition is clock.
You are welcome to come to this if it is your first competition, but note that many of the usual events will not be held.

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/speedcubingau) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
